profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Building systems of people, tools, and processes to better deliver software.

positions.title: Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Responsible for providing technical leadership across the 35 person QA organization, including:

- Providing technical support and implementation for migration effort to replace legacy BDD test framework with Python automation (using Pytest/Selenium) and revamp how Granular does testing within CI/CD.
- Developing Pytest plugins in support of internal test framework.
- Partnering with engineering/cloud to develop QA technical strategy.
- Mentoring engineers within QA organization on Python, Gitlab CI, and test/CICD philosophy.

Primary technologies used: Gitlab CI, Python/Pytest, Docker

positions.title: Systems Development Engineer II
positions.description:
- Contributed to Python CI/CD automation tooling to verify service dependency status at deployment as well as continuous monitoring/validation, used across all AWS Networking core services.
- Developed Ruby infrastructure as code templates to enable dynamic alarm severity throughout new region builds.
- Provided production support/maintenance to application servicing 400M requests/day across all AWS regions.
- Updated/maintained infrastructure as code templates, enabling zero touch deployments.
- Participated in 24x7 on-call rotation for production support, including giving a team OnCall 101 presentation

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Led technical initiative and guild to standardize how Workiva does active monitoring across its services. Responsible for coordinating with service teams, SRE/infrastructure, and architecture. 

Tech lead for a small squad of SDETs building CI, monitoring tooling, and supporting infrastructure as code for our product line. 

Primary point of contact regarding loadtesting and synthetic monitoring for R/D organization.

-- Developed python library to facilitate synthetic monitoring of production applications
-- Provided technical direction for squad of 3 engineers
-- Built framework for simultaneous integration testing and local story validation for Docker service stack
-- Migrated production services to Kubernetes
-- Maintainer for Locustio/Locust loadtesting framework

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Led Workiva's initiatives to load-test our products. Directly worked with individual teams to help them understand the use cases and technology needed for load-testing their products.

 -- Researched and developed load testing framework for Workiva infrastructure
 -- Coordinated and lead efforts to unify overall SDET organization within Workiva
 -- Reduced team CI process time by 75%+
 -- Developed internal Python tool to facilitate load-testing
 -- Implemented Python/Docker fault testing framework to test messaging stack failure conditions

positions.title: IT Analyst - SAP Integration
positions.description:
Developed of ETL models using SAP Data Services

 -- SQL Server, DB2, SAP source/targets 
 -- System administration and user maintenance/permissions for 100+ users
 -- Multi-national, remote team (Brazil, Germany, India)
 -- Research and implement integration process improvements

positions.title: Software Developer (Engineering Development Program)
positions.description: Worked on an Agile team in support of cross platform embedded application build systems used by several hundred other developers.

positions.title: Developer (Manufacturing Engineering Development Program)
positions.description:
Implemented database/front end system for internal service team.

The system provides project request, tracking, and documentation functionality for 50 users for 1000+ projects each year, while automating tedious tasks.

 -- $100,000+ cost savings/year
 -- SQL Server 2008 / Access VBA
 -- IE/SAP automation scripting
